_comment: WHO the cat is: art + name + footprint. Same npc shape as any person -- WHERE it sits is an Npc entity in the map naming this id; WHAT it 'says' is speaker-flagged psyche content (its readings are the player's perception; a voiced remark is its voice). It never speaks words, which is just an npc with no speaker lines. Idle row is the sitting poses (a cat at rest sits); walking uses the two-frame pads.
name: the cat
